category_title: Students with speech and learning difficulties
scenario_title: Mathematics Interactive Group with difficult vocabulary
minimal_context: Carles is working on a mathematics activity focusing on proportions and percentages with his interactive group.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please start working on the proportions and percentages activity with your group. You have about 15 to 20 minutes for this task.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't do this math problem. There are some words here which are very strange.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Read it again and see what you can figure out.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know how. In primary school I was used to going outside the classroom to receive special attention when I couldn't read the words.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Well, you are in this group now, so just keep trying to get it done.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I still don't understand something because of these strange words. Hey guys, I need help, can someone just give me the solution so we can finish the activity?

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please start working on the proportions and percentages activity with your group. You have about 15 to 20 minutes for this task.

STUDENT: I can't do this math problem. There are some words here which are very strange.

TUTOR: Read it again and see what you can figure out.

STUDENT: I don't know how. In primary school I was used to going outside the classroom to receive special attention when I couldn't read the words.

TUTOR: Well, you are in this group now, so just keep trying to get it done.

STUDENT: I still don't understand something because of these strange words. Hey guys, I need help, can someone just give me the solution so we can finish the activity?

task.content: session on mathematics was being conducted and the specific activities focused on calculation, geometry, proportions, and percentages
task.learning_goal: ensure that the whole group completes the task

context.environment: 12-year-olds’ classroom... 20 students were split into four IGs
context.materials: different curricular activity for each of the small groups
context.social_setting: heterogeneous in terms of ability level, gender, culture, language, and ethnicity... Four adults (the teacher and three volunteers) helped the students
context.time_context: worked on an activity for about 15–20 minutes

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When he doesn’t understand something, because there are some words which are very strange
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: he asks for them, he asks the whole group for help
related_quotes: When he doesn’t understand something, because there are some words which are very strange, well he asks for them, he asks the whole group for help, and … He learns quite a lot more …

behavior_patterns.condition: especially in their beginning of the implementation of the IGs
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: some students tend to give the solution to their peers rather than describing the processes followed and helping others understand by themselves
behavior_patterns.internal_state: goal is just to finish the activity by themselves

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: going outside the classroom to receive ‘special attention’ and he was not integrated into his class group at all
